_doc: Change control for the merge gate (AA-1162, tech lead decision D4 of S286; skill aa-ship section 1).
require_human_approval_for_risky OFF (false) = the merge tool behaves as before.
ON (true) = it refuses a risky PR until a human (non-bot) reviewer APPROVED its current head commit.
Trigger to switch it ON: the first pilot with real data, at the latest the first prod or paying tenant.
Switch it by a root PR that edits this file; while ON, a PR that changes this file is itself risky.
risky = a PR label in risky_labels, or a changed file matching risky_paths (fnmatch, '*' crosses '/')
and not matching ignore_paths (text-only files never make a PR risky).
approvers: GitHub logins whose approval counts; empty = any human reviewer other than the PR author.
exempt_authors: PR authors never classified risky (bot copies of files already approved in their app PR).
